<title>Fennimore Print: morning stand-up</title>
<transcript>
[0] Kit Varga: Right, quick one.
[1] Kit Varga: Press two.
[2] Lorna Hesp: Down.
[3] Kit Varga: Since when?
[4] Lorna Hesp: Since six this morning.
[5] Lorna Hesp: The feeder jammed.
[6] Ravi Dunne: Again?
[7] Lorna Hesp: Again.
[8] Lorna Hesp: Third time this week.
[9] Kit Varga: Who's on it?
[10] Shay Corrigan: Me.
[11] Shay Corrigan: The engineer's coming at two.
[12] Kit Varga: Today?
[13] Shay Corrigan: Today.
[14] Shay Corrigan: Two o'clock.
[15] Kit Varga: And the school brochures?
[16] Ravi Dunne: Half done.
[17] Kit Varga: Half of what?
[18] Ravi Dunne: Half of 4,000.
[19] Ravi Dunne: So 2,000 printed.
[20] Lorna Hesp: They're due Thursday.
[21] Kit Varga: Can press one take the rest?
[22] Ravi Dunne: Not until the menus are off it.
[23] Kit Varga: When's that?
[24] Ravi Dunne: Lunchtime.
[25] Ravi Dunne: Maybe one.
[26] Shay Corrigan: The menus are 600 copies.
[27] Shay Corrigan: They're nearly through.
[28] Kit Varga: So brochures go on press one this afternoon.
[29] Ravi Dunne: Yes.
[30] Ravi Dunne: If nothing else breaks.
[31] Lorna Hesp: Paper.
[32] Kit Varga: What about it?
[33] Lorna Hesp: We're short.
[34] Lorna Hesp: Two pallets left of the brochure stock.
[35] Kit Varga: Is that enough?
[36] Lorna Hesp: For 2,000 brochures, just.
[37] Lorna Hesp: Nothing spare.
[38] Kit Varga: Order more.
[39] Lorna Hesp: Ordered.
[40] Lorna Hesp: It lands Friday.
[41] Kit Varga: Friday's after Thursday.
[42] Lorna Hesp: I know.
[43] Lorna Hesp: That's why I said nothing spare.
[44] Shay Corrigan: I'll watch the waste.
[45] Kit Varga: Do.
[46] Kit Varga: Anything else?
[47] Ravi Dunne: The folder's fine now.
[48] Kit Varga: Good.
[49] Kit Varga: Back at four.
</transcript>

points.text: Press two has been down since 6am because the feeder jammed, the third time this week.
Shay Corrigan is on the press two problem, and the engineer is due at 2pm today.
The school brochures (4,000 copies, due Thursday) are half done, with 2,000 printed.
Press one can't take the remaining brochures until the 600-copy menu job is finished, expected around lunchtime or 1pm.
Plan: brochures go on press one this afternoon, provided nothing else breaks.
Brochure paper stock is tight: two pallets left, just enough for 2,000 brochures with nothing spare.
More paper has been ordered but arrives Friday, after the Thursday deadline; Shay will watch waste.
The folder is working fine now.
